recentItems.title: Dune: Part Three - Exclusive Teaser Trailer (2026) Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Robert Pattinson
recentItems.description:
From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.
 
Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

 The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

 Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Tanya Lapointe, Villeneuve, Cale Boyter and Joe Caracciolo, Jr., and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

 Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-winning visual effects supervisor Paul Lambert and visual effects supervisor Mag Sarnowska, Oscar-winning visual effects house DNEG, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

 Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production In Association With Image Nation Studios, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

recentItems.title: Marvel Rivals - Official Incursion Point Map Reveal Trailer
recentItems.description: Here's a look at the Incursion Point Map Reveal Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based free-to-play action shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players can get a look at a new map that blends two worlds into one. Head into battle at the center of universes on a collision course in Incursion Point, launching on November 26 for Marvel Rivals on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

recentItems.title: I Fed Jason 55,780 Calories in GTA 6... (Instant Regret)
recentItems.description:
GTA 6 features an in-depth fitness and wellness system, with Jason and Lucia having their own unique fitness levels and trackers for each other, but what happens when you stop focusing on your Strength, Cardio, and Focus levels? Well, we made Jason suffer through thousands and thousands of calories in Grand Theft Auto 6, ignoring his workout windows to go on eating sprees.

From max muscle to max fat, burgers and beers, we fed Jason 55,780 calories in GTA 6 (and we regretted it).

#IGN #GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto

recentItems.title: Attack on Titan 3 - Official ‘Explorations Within the Walls’ Gameplay
recentItems.description: Check out the ‘Explorations Within the Walls’ Gameplay for Attack on Titan 3, an upcoming anime action game developed by Koei Tecmo Games. Players can take a look at the social interactions, activities, and more to engage in within the towering walls. Upgrade equipment, talk to characters, and explore life from the confines of the city in Attack on Titan 3, launching on December 10 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Monster Hunter Outlanders - Official Stylia Skill Overview Trailer
recentItems.description: Don't miss the Stylia Skill Overview Trailer for Monster Hunter Outlanders, an open-world survival mobile action monster-hunting game developed by TiMi Studio Group. Players can get a look at Stylia's abilities, including her Rapid Fire ice bow basic attack, Waltz skill, Swan Step skill, and more. Freeze the battlefield as Stylia in Monster Hunter Outlanders on November 27 for iOS and Android.

recentItems.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - Official Accolades Overview Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the Accolades Overview Trailer for The Blood of Dawnwalker, the hit action RPG developed by Rebel Wolves. Players can garner the critical reception behind the hit vampiric adventure to embody Coen as he walks as a mortal warrior by day and a violent vampire by night to save his family. The Blood of Dawnwalker is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Guns of Eschaton - Official Co-op Trailer
recentItems.description:
Take a look at co-op gameplay from Guns of Eschaton in this new trailer for the upcoming occult Soulslike FPS game. Guns of Eschaton pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-op—go West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

Guns of Eschaton will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and Steam on December 8, 2026.

recentItems.title: Marathon - Official Bishop Shell Cinematic Trailer
recentItems.description: Get a look at the Bishop Shell Cinematic Trailer for Marathon, the hit sci-fi first-person extraction shooter developed by Bungie. Players can check out the new Shell class in action with the melee-based Bishop, a Shell with unprecedented speed and agility. Fight as Bishop with the Symbiosis Update on December 8 for Marathon on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Nioh 3 - Official Bloody Insurrection DLC Vol. 2 Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description:
Watch the latest trailer for Nioh 3 to see what to expect from the Bloody Insurrection DLC for the action RPG, which brings a new setting, new Martial Arts for each weapon type, a new difficulty mode, the conclusion to Takechiyo's story, and more. Nioh 3 is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Windows PC via Steam. The second DLC, Bloody Insurrection, will be available on December 17, 2026. Nioh 3: Complete Edition will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Windows PC via Steam, and Xbox Series X/S on January 28, 2027.

In Bloody Insurrection, players will transcend time once more, setting out into the new stage, Shimabara, in the year 1638. Here, fans will become embroiled in the conflict between rebel forces, alchemists and yokai as these forces rally against the shogunate army alongside protagonist Takechiyo. Along the way, players will encounter both familiar faces from previous entries in the franchise, such as legendary warrior Tachibana Muneshige, as well as new figures, including rebel leader Amakusa Shiro and a samurai battling the Spanish alchemists. As players explore Shimabara’s vast environments, from Hara Castle’s rebel stronghold to the caverns below Mount Unzen, they will discover the truth behind the plot spanning both DLCs and witness the thrilling conclusion of Takechiyo’s story.
